Male voice (optional): The default Google Translate voice is female. The brain code can use Gemini TTS for a male voice, with the same GEMINI_API_KEY. The gemini-3.8-flash-tts model has a free daily quota and recognizes Indonesian on its own.

In the brain code, SUARA_GEMINI holds the voice name. The default is Puck (male, upbeat). Other male voices: Charon (calm), Orus (firm), Fenrir (excitable). Listen first in AI Studio (Generate speech) with an Indonesian sentence, then pick the one you like.

SUARA_GAYA sets the speaking style in free-form words, for example santai dan ramah (relaxed and friendly) or pelan dan tenang (slow and calm). Leave it empty for a neutral style. Accent and gender come from the voice name, not from the style.
Upload the brain code (over WiFi as in Step 4), then type /bilang halo, aku Zond in Telegram.
In the web panel (Musik dan suara section) you can switch between the male voice and Google, and see how many Gemini sentences have been used today. In Telegram: /suara, /suara google, /suara gemini.

Why does it work this way? The brain code sends the sentence to Gemini TTS and receives 16 kHz WAV audio as base64. The audio is saved in the S3's flash memory (the same 9.9 MB FATFS partition required for WiFi uploads), then played. Because the voice is generated by AI first, the pause before speaking is longer than with the Google voice, about 1-4 seconds per sentence. If Gemini fails, that sentence is spoken right away with the Google voice, so the robot never goes silent.
The robot speaks with a male voice. The Serial Monitor prints lines such as [suara] Gemini 2100 ms, kalimat ke-12 hari ini.

The bot sends "Suara Gemini gagal (kode 429)": the free daily voice quota is used up, or requests are too frequent. The robot uses the Google voice and retries Gemini 5 minutes later. Your quota limits are shown on the AI Studio rate limit page.

Code 400 or 404: the model name or voice name is misspelled. Google's message is also sent to Telegram and the Serial Monitor. If Google has renamed the model, look up the current name in the Gemini documentation (Speech generation section) and change SUARA_MODEL.
Pause too long: change SUARA_MODEL to gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts (faster, slightly less natural), or go back to the Google voice with /suara google.
